home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to level up

features.title: Multiplayer & singleplayer
features.text: Games are marked MP, SP or both, so you find the right service for the mode you actually play.

features.title: Configurable boosts
features.text: Platform and boost amount are set before checkout — your selection is the order, no hidden steps.

features.title: A live catalog
features.text: Every game, price and service here is managed and updated by the Rowmodz team.

features.title: Support when you need it
features.text: The help center is one click away from any page in the store.

help.title: Support
help.faq1a: Open a game, pick a service and set your platform and boost amount. That exact configuration is what you add to your cart and order.
help.faq2a: Your configured selection is confirmed and removed from the cart. Every order in the catalog is reviewed by the Rowmodz team.
help.faq3q: Does the crypto payment really work?
help.faq3a: Not in this build. Checkout is a demo — no wallet connection or blockchain transaction is actually performed.
